summary: Analyzed the business/legal precondition risk where the client lacks a Stripe merchant account and established the architectural decoupling plan.
evidence: Identified the blocker as a non-technical Business/Legal Precondition Risk.
Decoupled development using an abstract PaymentGateway interface and mock adapter.
Promoted Booking Concurrency (novelty risk) to active build target to maintain momentum while legal paperwork clears.
